name: Kingy AI Price Index
citation: Kingy AI Price Index, June 2025 edition. Kingy AI. https://kingy.ai/ai-price-index/2025-06/

edition.label: June 2025
edition.headline: In June 2025, a million AI tokens cost a median $3.47 from frontier models (down 0.9%), $0.75 from mid-range models and $0.26 from small models (down 25.0%). A typical AI subscription cost $20.00 a month (no change), and top plans cost $200.00. Changes compare with May.

story.title: Small-model prices fell 25% in June
story.text: The median small model cost $0.26 per million tokens, down from $0.35 in May. Mistral AI is now counted.
